event_overview.outposts: Map structures categorized by levels (1 to 4). They provide permanent, passive alliance-wide buffs (e.g., Attack/Defense bonuses, Training Speedup, Gathering Speedup, March Speedup). Outpost buffs remain active even when crossing to another server during Kingdom of Power (KvK).
event_overview.sanctuaries_and_fortresses: High-value structures that offer massive rewards, season points, and powerful kingdom buffs. Sanctuaries generally grant better rewards than Fortresses. These battles are weekly cornerstone events for alliance warfare.

registration_and_requirements.territory_connection: CRITICAL DIFFERENCE: To attack an Outpost, your Alliance Territory (Banners) MUST be physically touching the Outpost. Sanctuaries and Fortresses DO NOT require any territory connection; you can teleport directly to them.
registration_and_requirements.sanctuary_signup: Only R4 and R5 members of an alliance with 20+ members can register. In a given phase, an alliance can sign up for 1 Sanctuary and 1 Fortress. If you occupied a Sanctuary/Fortress in the previous phase, you are automatically registered for it and can still select one new structure.
registration_and_requirements.battle_time_selection: During Sanctuary/Fortress sign-up, R4/R5 leaders vote on 3 preferred time slots. The game server averages all alliances' votes to determine the final battle time.

battle_and_win_conditions.npc_defenders: When the battle starts, Sanctuaries, Fortresses, and Outposts are occupied by NPCs (Cesares' Rebels). Defeating them grants the 'First Victory' occupation reward.
battle_and_win_conditions.continuous_occupation_outposts: To win an Outpost, you must hold it for a continuous timer based on its level: Lv.1 = 15 mins, Lv.2 = 20 mins, Lv.3 = 25 mins, Lv.4 = 30 mins.
battle_and_win_conditions.continuous_occupation_sanctuaries: To win a Sanctuary or Fortress, an alliance must continuously occupy the building for 30 minutes during the battle phase.
battle_and_win_conditions.timer_expiration: If the battle is highly contested and no alliance manages to hold the structure for the required continuous time limit, control goes to the LAST alliance occupying the building when the 2-hour overall event timer expires.

casualty_and_loss_mechanics.sanctuary_and_fortress: 0% permanent troop loss. Troops are Severely Injured and sent to the Infirmary. However, if your Infirmary is 100% full, overflow troops go to the Enlistment Office and require significant time/resources to recover.
casualty_and_loss_mechanics.outposts_lv_1_to_3: 0% permanent troop loss. Troops are Severely Injured and sent to the Infirmary.
casualty_and_loss_mechanics.outposts_lv_4: ⚠️ LETHAL BATTLES. Battles at Lv.4 Outposts (like the Arsenal) result in a 10% PERMANENT TROOP LOSS. Troops lost here die permanently and cannot be recovered.

attack_rally.purpose: Used to break an enemy-held structure. Provides a thick frontline of Infantry to absorb the garrison's damage while Archers deal high DPS to the enemy.

defense_garrison.ratio: 60% Infantry / 20% Cavalry / 20% Archers (6/2/2) or 70% Infantry / 30% Cavalry / 0% Archers.
defense_garrison.purpose: Used for holding the structure once captured. Maximizes Infantry HP to soak incoming damage and survive the opponent's rallies to run out the occupation timer.

garrison_reinforcement.purpose: In Kingshot combat simulations, Infantry takes the frontline damage and goes to the infirmary first. If a garrison takes multiple hits, the Infantry dies off, leaving the ratio vulnerable (e.g., 20% Inf / 40% Cav / 40% Arch). Players must constantly reinforce the garrison with PURE INFANTRY to keep the ratio above 60% so the garrison does not collapse.

hero_selection.rally_leaders: The strongest player (highest stats/tech) MUST lead. The Leader's stats, research, pet buffs, and all three heroes apply to the entire rally.
hero_selection.attack_joiners: For players joining a rally, ONLY the first hero's top-right expedition skill matters. Gear and stats do not apply. Joiners should send heroes that boost Lethality or Attack in the 1st slot (e.g., Chenko, Yeonwoo, Amane).
hero_selection.defense_joiners: Joiners should send heroes that boost Health or Damage Reduction in the 1st slot (e.g., Gordon, Howard, Saul, Hilde).

advanced_tactics.never_solo_first_capture: 🚨 NEVER solo attack an uncontested Sanctuary's NPCs. You must set a massive alliance rally. The game grants 'First Capture' Alliance Rewards based on how many players participated in killing the rebels. A solo attack robs your entire alliance of up to 15x more loot.
advanced_tactics.cascading_double_rallies: To unseat a massive Whale garrisoning a Sanctuary, coordinate 'cascading rallies.' Stagger two immediate alliance rallies to land at exactly the same time (or 1-2 seconds apart) so the enemy cannot heal or reinforce their frontline Infantry before the second lethal blow lands.
advanced_tactics.the_last_10_minutes_snipe: Because the absolute win condition is 'whoever holds it at the 2-hour mark', alliances that cannot hold for the full 30 minutes should wait until the last 10 minutes of the event. During the last 10 minutes, use a free Advanced Teleport to jump in, snipe the Sanctuary, and turtle up until the 2-hour timer expires.
advanced_tactics.grid_positioning: Kingshot uses a diagonal square grid. For the fastest march time when teleporting next to a Sanctuary, align your city directly with the FLAT side of the structure's center tile, NEVER the corners.

server_politics_and_nap.nap_assignments: In most mature Kingshot servers, Sanctuaries and Fortresses are pre-assigned by the top alliances as part of a NAP (Non-Aggression Pact) to allow the server to grow power for KvK (Kingdom of Power).
server_politics_and_nap.rogue_attacks: Going rogue and attacking a NAP-assigned Sanctuary will usually result in your entire alliance being zeroed/burned by the server's whales.
